值得閱讀的理由

  • 從開箱、規格到實測，完整呈現高價迷你 AI 主機 DGX Spark 的優勢與限制。
  • 比較 DGX Spark 與 128GB 統一記憶體的 ST Halo，說明記憶體頻寬、模型架構和推論引擎如何影響速度。
  • 透過不同模型的測試，揭示 Spark 的大容量統一記憶體在哪些情境下才真正有價值。

摘要

高價入手與開箱

作者介紹自己購入的 NVIDIA DGX Spark，並稱它是自己買過價值密度最高的迷你電腦，不過嚴格來說更像一台微型伺服器。儘管官方售價比最初公布時高出超過五成，作者仍花了三萬六千多元分期購入完整規格版本；他原本還訂了兩台，後來取消其中一台。影片將以自費方式，對比 Spark 和搭載 128GB 統一記憶體的 ST Halo，探討 Spark 是否值得這筆投入。

外觀、連接埠與核心規格

Spark 外箱採用簡潔的環保紙材，機身則相當緊湊且有分量，金屬網格面板帶來頗具質感的外觀。它使用外接 Type-C 電源，配備四個 Type-C、一個 10GbE 網路埠、一個 HDMI，以及兩個企業級 200Gb QSFP56 埠。核心 GB10 SoC 配有大量處理器核心、Blackwell 架構 GPU，以及128GB 統一記憶體和 4TB SSD。作者指出，GB10 的 GPU 規格約可比擬 RTX 5070，但整體運算能力仍無法與 RTX 5090 相提並論。

效能優勢與記憶體頻寬瓶頸

基準測試顯示，GB10 的單核 CPU 效能大致接近 Apple M3，多核表現則可逼近桌上型第 12 代 x86 處理器。不過，Spark 的關鍵限制是採用 LPDDR5X，記憶體頻寬標稱只有273GB/s，與價格約為 Spark 六成的 ST Halo 相近。由於大型語言模型推論常受記憶體頻寬限制，作者接著透過實測檢視：Spark 的大容量記憶體與較強算力，究竟能否彌補頻寬不足。

不同模型與推論引擎的實測

測試中，Spark 使用原生 DGOS，並以 Llama.cpp、SGLang 和 vLLM 執行推論；ST Halo 則主要以 Llama.cpp 比較，因為其他引擎對其 GFX1151 架構的支援和最佳化仍不成熟。對於 Qwen 27B 這類密集模型，Spark 的解碼速度表現平平：不用 vLLM 時略高於每秒 10 個 token，使用 vLLM 時約為每秒 26 至 27 個 token，仍受頻寬限制。相較之下，採用 MoE 架構的 35B A3B 每次只啟用部分參數，Spark 的解碼優勢較明顯；在長提示詞的Prefill 階段，它也能更快處理輸入內容、縮短等待首個 token 的時間。多使用者並發時，Spark 搭配 vLLM 或 SGLang 的整體吞吐量也優於 Llama.cpp。

大容量記憶體的適用場景

作者認為，35B A3B 的成績還不足以充分展現 Spark 的 128GB 統一記憶體價值，因為更便宜的獨立顯示卡也能達到相近水準。更適合測試這項優勢的，是新推出的 Qwen 1.5 180B-Flash-NEX：模型包含 125B 主模型與 51B 查找表，查找表十分佔用記憶體，但生成每個 token 時不必讀取全部內容，因此額外頻寬負擔相對有限。相同模型與量化設定下，Spark 的單流生成速度約每秒 30 個 token，ST Halo 約每秒 28 個；Spark 更突出的優勢在 Prefill，短上下文測試接近 900，而對照平台略高於 500。整體而言，Spark 的 Prefill 約快1.5 至 2 倍。作者最後提到，新版 FlashAttention-4 及社群對大型查找表的最佳化仍在發展中，這類模型尚有提升空間。

Vulkan by the built-in DXVK. The key is that these three layers are all bundled by Steam for you; FEX is already in the official ARM version of Steam, and Proton is automatically downloaded the first time you enter a game. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 從開箱、規格到實測，完整呈現高價迷你 AI 主機 DGX Spark 的優勢與限制。
  • 比較 DGX Spark 與 128GB 統一記憶體的 ST Halo，說明記憶體頻寬、模型架構和推論引擎如何影響速度。
  • 透過不同模型的測試，揭示 Spark 的大容量統一記憶體在哪些情境下才真正有價值。

摘要

高價入手與開箱

作者介紹自己購入的 NVIDIA DGX Spark，並稱它是自己買過價值密度最高的迷你電腦，不過嚴格來說更像一台微型伺服器。儘管官方售價比最初公布時高出超過五成，作者仍花了三萬六千多元分期購入完整規格版本；他原本還訂了兩台，後來取消其中一台。影片將以自費方式，對比 Spark 和搭載 128GB 統一記憶體的 ST Halo，探討 Spark 是否值得這筆投入。

外觀、連接埠與核心規格

Spark 外箱採用簡潔的環保紙材，機身則相當緊湊且有分量，金屬網格面板帶來頗具質感的外觀。它使用外接 Type-C 電源，配備四個 Type-C、一個 10GbE 網路埠、一個 HDMI，以及兩個企業級 200Gb QSFP56 埠。核心 GB10 SoC 配有大量處理器核心、Blackwell 架構 GPU，以及128GB 統一記憶體和 4TB SSD。作者指出，GB10 的 GPU 規格約可比擬 RTX 5070，但整體運算能力仍無法與 RTX 5090 相提並論。

效能優勢與記憶體頻寬瓶頸

基準測試顯示，GB10 的單核 CPU 效能大致接近 Apple M3，多核表現則可逼近桌上型第 12 代 x86 處理器。不過，Spark 的關鍵限制是採用 LPDDR5X，記憶體頻寬標稱只有273GB/s，與價格約為 Spark 六成的 ST Halo 相近。由於大型語言模型推論常受記憶體頻寬限制，作者接著透過實測檢視：Spark 的大容量記憶體與較強算力，究竟能否彌補頻寬不足。

不同模型與推論引擎的實測

測試中，Spark 使用原生 DGOS，並以 Llama.cpp、SGLang 和 vLLM 執行推論；ST Halo 則主要以 Llama.cpp 比較，因為其他引擎對其 GFX1151 架構的支援和最佳化仍不成熟。對於 Qwen 27B 這類密集模型，Spark 的解碼速度表現平平：不用 vLLM 時略高於每秒 10 個 token，使用 vLLM 時約為每秒 26 至 27 個 token，仍受頻寬限制。相較之下，採用 MoE 架構的 35B A3B 每次只啟用部分參數，Spark 的解碼優勢較明顯；在長提示詞的Prefill 階段，它也能更快處理輸入內容、縮短等待首個 token 的時間。多使用者並發時，Spark 搭配 vLLM 或 SGLang 的整體吞吐量也優於 Llama.cpp。

大容量記憶體的適用場景

作者認為，35B A3B 的成績還不足以充分展現 Spark 的 128GB 統一記憶體價值，因為更便宜的獨立顯示卡也能達到相近水準。更適合測試這項優勢的，是新推出的 Qwen 1.5 180B-Flash-NEX：模型包含 125B 主模型與 51B 查找表，查找表十分佔用記憶體，但生成每個 token 時不必讀取全部內容，因此額外頻寬負擔相對有限。相同模型與量化設定下，Spark 的單流生成速度約每秒 30 個 token，ST Halo 約每秒 28 個；Spark 更突出的優勢在 Prefill，短上下文測試接近 900，而對照平台略高於 500。整體而言，Spark 的 Prefill 約快1.5 至 2 倍。作者最後提到，新版 FlashAttention-4 及社群對大型查找表的最佳化仍在發展中，這類模型尚有提升空間。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 從開箱、規格到實測，完整呈現高價迷你 AI 主機 DGX Spark 的優勢與限制。
  • 比較 DGX Spark 與 128GB 統一記憶體的 ST Halo，說明記憶體頻寬、模型架構和推論引擎如何影響速度。
  • 透過不同模型的測試，揭示 Spark 的大容量統一記憶體在哪些情境下才真正有價值。

摘要

高價入手與開箱

作者介紹自己購入的 NVIDIA DGX Spark，並稱它是自己買過價值密度最高的迷你電腦，不過嚴格來說更像一台微型伺服器。儘管官方售價比最初公布時高出超過五成，作者仍花了三萬六千多元分期購入完整規格版本；他原本還訂了兩台，後來取消其中一台。影片將以自費方式，對比 Spark 和搭載 128GB 統一記憶體的 ST Halo，探討 Spark 是否值得這筆投入。

外觀、連接埠與核心規格

Spark 外箱採用簡潔的環保紙材，機身則相當緊湊且有分量，金屬網格面板帶來頗具質感的外觀。它使用外接 Type-C 電源，配備四個 Type-C、一個 10GbE 網路埠、一個 HDMI，以及兩個企業級 200Gb QSFP56 埠。核心 GB10 SoC 配有大量處理器核心、Blackwell 架構 GPU，以及128GB 統一記憶體和 4TB SSD。作者指出，GB10 的 GPU 規格約可比擬 RTX 5070，但整體運算能力仍無法與 RTX 5090 相提並論。

效能優勢與記憶體頻寬瓶頸

基準測試顯示，GB10 的單核 CPU 效能大致接近 Apple M3，多核表現則可逼近桌上型第 12 代 x86 處理器。不過，Spark 的關鍵限制是採用 LPDDR5X，記憶體頻寬標稱只有273GB/s，與價格約為 Spark 六成的 ST Halo 相近。由於大型語言模型推論常受記憶體頻寬限制，作者接著透過實測檢視：Spark 的大容量記憶體與較強算力，究竟能否彌補頻寬不足。

不同模型與推論引擎的實測

測試中，Spark 使用原生 DGOS，並以 Llama.cpp、SGLang 和 vLLM 執行推論；ST Halo 則主要以 Llama.cpp 比較，因為其他引擎對其 GFX1151 架構的支援和最佳化仍不成熟。對於 Qwen 27B 這類密集模型，Spark 的解碼速度表現平平：不用 vLLM 時略高於每秒 10 個 token，使用 vLLM 時約為每秒 26 至 27 個 token，仍受頻寬限制。相較之下，採用 MoE 架構的 35B A3B 每次只啟用部分參數，Spark 的解碼優勢較明顯；在長提示詞的Prefill 階段，它也能更快處理輸入內容、縮短等待首個 token 的時間。多使用者並發時，Spark 搭配 vLLM 或 SGLang 的整體吞吐量也優於 Llama.cpp。

大容量記憶體的適用場景

作者認為，35B A3B 的成績還不足以充分展現 Spark 的 128GB 統一記憶體價值，因為更便宜的獨立顯示卡也能達到相近水準。更適合測試這項優勢的，是新推出的 Qwen 1.5 180B-Flash-NEX：模型包含 125B 主模型與 51B 查找表，查找表十分佔用記憶體，但生成每個 token 時不必讀取全部內容，因此額外頻寬負擔相對有限。相同模型與量化設定下，Spark 的單流生成速度約每秒 30 個 token，ST Halo 約每秒 28 個；Spark 更突出的優勢在 Prefill，短上下文測試接近 900，而對照平台略高於 500。整體而言，Spark 的 Prefill 約快1.5 至 2 倍。作者最後提到，新版 FlashAttention-4 及社群對大型查找表的最佳化仍在發展中，這類模型尚有提升空間。

Taking the current mainstream video model Minimax-H 3 as an example, we ran four test profiles: 0.4 MP, 0.9 MP, and 2MP for 5-second clips, plus a 10-second video at 2MP. We’ve displayed the generation times on screen. When the total frame count of the video doubles, the duration roughly triples; this is an algorithmic necessity determined by the token count. , regardless of the card used. One detail worth noting is that for the 2MP 1080p 10-second video, the generated frame count reaches over 240 frames. The VRAM usage for this level is quite intense even for 32GB cards. Next, let’s look at this horizontally ; in terms of specifications, the SPARK hardware’s theoretical parameters are. roughly on par with the 5070. This is. where the 2.8 x time difference per step comes from. RTX 4070 Ti or 4080—or even a 32GB graphics card in the 10,000-yuan range —would be the "sweet spot." 魔改顯示卡背景與單卡 AI 推理實測

作者響應網友建議，購入了兩張七彩虹 RTX 2080 Ti 22G 魔改版顯示卡與 NVLink 橋接器，旨在驗證這款經典顯示卡在現代 AI 領域的實際應用潛力。硬體改裝將原本的 11GB 顯存擴充至 22GB 顯存，並搭建了 i5-13600K 平台進行測試。在傳統遊戲測試中，其性能接近 RTX 3070；而在 Linux 環境下部署專門優化的 vLLM 後，單卡執行 Qwen 2.5 27B 量化模型可達每秒 28 個 Token 的生成速度。

作者實測啟用雙卡張量並行（TP=2）後，模型生成速度提升至每秒 45 個 Token，且 KV Cache 容量暴增至 650k Token，可輕鬆支援 16 至 32 人的高併發對話需求。透過實測 NVLink 橋接器，雙卡雙向頻寬從 PCIe 的 7 GB/s 巨幅提升至 74 GB/s 以上。搭配 MVP（多向量預測）技術與 NVLink 加速後，16 並發速度更高達 846 tokens/s，大幅打破了傳統顯存頻寬瓶頸。

礦卡重生：CMP 170HX 的破解傳奇與硬體極限

作者指出，原本市價僅約千元人民幣且乏人問津的 CMP 170HX 礦卡，近期因破解技術身價暴漲破萬。這張卡本質上採用了與 NVIDIA 頂級資料中心運算卡 A100 相同的 GA100 核心，但出廠時被官方施加了三重封印：顯存被閹割至 8GB 或 10GB、算力限制在 32%，且 PCIe 匯流排被鎖定在 PCIe 1.0。然而，技術人員利用其啟動驗證未檢驗長度的漏洞取得 Root 權限，成功解除算力限制並將 Hynix 顆粒版本解鎖至 64GB HBM2e 顯存；若在 PCB 上補焊電容並搭配軟體修改，更能將匯流排頻寬提升至 PCIe 2.0 x16。實測顯示，該卡的實際讀寫頻寬突破 1.7 TB/s，足以與最新的 RTX 5090 匹敵。不過，作者也提醒該卡需在 Linux 系統特定驅動下運作，且屬於無風扇被動散熱，必須仰賴伺服器高轉速風扇壓制溫度，入門門檻極高。

然而，在 大語言模型（LLM）推論部署 上，這張卡展現了令人驚駭的實力，也是其身價飆漲的核心主因。作者透過 vLLM 框架部署了 Qwen 27B 與 Mixtral 8x7B (35B) 模型，在單串流解碼下，27B 模型生成速度達每秒 60 tokens，35B 更達 151 tokens，若啟用 Medusa 投機解碼 更可分別衝破 100 與 180 tokens，媲美雲端商業 API。在 128 併發的高負載測試中，35B 模型的總吞吐量飆升至每秒近 4,000 tokens，即便 32 人同時呼叫也能維持流暢回應。作者分析，解碼任務極度依賴頻寬，GA100 帶來的 1.6 TB/s 記憶體頻寬 與龐大的 KV Cache 容量，使其在推論速度上徹底輾壓 RTX 4090，面對多 Agent 協同調用或長文本 RAG 場景時表現尤為頂級，成為本地推論極具競爭力的硬核選擇。

Even when listed at. an astonishing five-figure price, or. just over 10,000 yuan, there are still. people snapping them up. You might not. know that the chip inside is called the. This card is the CMP 170HX. released by NVIDIA in 2021. As the name. suggests, it’s a pure mining card, no. secrets there. It uses a passive. heatsink with no fans, and its power. input is an 8-pin CPU connector,. requiring an adapter for standard GPU. power cables. The total power draw is. 250 watts. What’s truly special is. the chip; although it uses the same. GA100 core as the A100, it arrived from. the factory with three layers of locks. First is the VRAM: it physically has. 64GB or 80GB of HBM2e soldered on, but. only 8GB or 10GB is unlocked. Second,. the compute core is throttled to 32%of. the A100, performing worse than. decade-old cards. Third is the PCIe. link, limited to PCIe 1.0. Of course,. that didn't affect its primary job at. all. From the moment it left the. factory, it was built for one thing. only: mining. That’s why its price. hovered around 1,000 yuan for so long; treating it as electronic waste was. perfectly reasonable. So, how are these. locks removed? Simply put, you can. exploit a bug in its boot-up. verification process that doesn't check. length, allowing users to gain root. access and disable most of the. aforementioned restrictions, which. persists even after a reboot. The 8GB. version with Hynix memory can unlock to. 64GB of VRAM, while the 10GB version. uses Samsung chips, which are stable at. 40GB but prone to errors if pushed to. 80GB. Through software, we can upgrade. the PCIe version to 2.0. And if you. manually solder the missing capacitors. onto the PCB, the lane count can reach. x16, effectively restoring the. bandwidth to 2.0 x16. The factory-set. computing power, VRAM, and bus speed. have all been unlocked; overnight, it. transformed into an A100. This also. marks the starting point of its.

skyrocketing price. I picked up this. card about a month ago for 6,600 RMB,. but the current market prices are all. over the place—some over 10,000,. others around 9,000—and I have no. idea what a fair price actually is. Since this card requires forced cooling. , we are testing it in an Inspur 3-GPU. server. Note that we must set the fans. to over 75%to keep it cool; otherwise,. it will throttle, drop performance, and. generate extra noise. There is also a. major deterrent: the current unlock. process must be done in Linux, and the. drivers must be locked to the 610. series version. So, if you are a novice. with Linux, you can honestly just skip. this card entirely. My approach was to. have AI conduct a deep study on the. unlocking issues, compile a report, and. then have open-source code use that. research to automatically complete the. crack. After a reboot, you can see in. the NVIDIA SMI that the VRAM has become. 64GB, confirming the crack is complete. Before real-world testing, let's. establish a baseline: the card's actual. bandwidth is 1,747 GB/s for writes and. 1,679 GB/s for reads, both exceeding. the rated specs. So, what does this. number actually mean? The 4090 is at 1. TB/s, while the 5090 is at 1.79 TB/s; a. mined-out card is performing right. alongside a 5090, and all its. subsequent powerful performance is. built on this foundation. Alright, with. 64GB of VRAM and massive bandwidth,. let's start by running some popular AI. image and video generation tasks. Let's. jump straight to the highlight: testing. the high-demand, high-configuration. Mochi-1 video generation. We'll use the. Int8 model from the Mochi template. directly, requiring no manual. adaptation to get the best results. So,. how exactly is its generative. performance? If generating video at. lower specifications, its computing. power level is actually about the same. as a 4070 or 4080. Let's compare it. with the 10,000-yuan-level Intel Arc. Pro A70 we tested previously. In the. default 20-step scenario for 480p, 720p. , and 1080p, 24-frame, 5-second video. generation, the time difference is only. around 10%, which is not a significant. advantage. If you have a budget of. 10,000 yuan, at this price point, you. can easily buy a brand-new 32GB. graphics card with a warranty, such as. Intel's A770, AMD's Radeon Pro W7900. 32G, or even a modified 4080 32G. version. In the 1080p 5-second "sweet. spot," compared to cards like the 170HX. that have undergone intense mining and.

lack a warranty, these would definitely. be a safer choice. At this point,. experienced users might wonder, if we. switch the model to the newer FP8. version, could performance be boosted. further? We went ahead and tested it,. only to be proven wrong by the actual. results. The FP8 version was not faster. ; in fact, the rendering time increased. . The problem lies with the old GA100. architecture, as it lacks FP8 hardware. support. When running FP8 models on it,. the data must be dequantized to FP16. before calculation, relying on software. emulation, which leads to computational. overhead. So, does the 170HX still have. any advantages in AIGC? The 64GB of. VRAM is definitely still an advantage. Once you exceed the 1080p 5-second spec. —for instance, pushing to 6, 7, 8, or. even 10 seconds—VRAM usage will. surpass 32GB. If we still use an A770. or W7900 to run it, the graphics card. needs to frequently fetch data from. system memory, causing a sharper drop. in speed, while the 170HX, thanks to. its 64GB of VRAM, sees a relatively. gentler decline in generation speed. As. shown in the chart on the screen, we. can see that this gap isn't actually. that massive. This brings up another. question: is 1080p 10-second direct. output really a core necessity for you? In fact, various quantized model. versions and optimized workflows in the. community can lower VRAM requirements,. and you can always upscale the video. later via post-processing. Is it really. worth spending over 10,000 yuan on a. mined-out card just for these edge-case. scenarios? That is something for you. all to decide. After seeing the. multimedia and AI performance, some may. think it's just on par with a 4070 or. 4080, and might have some doubts about. its performance. But what we are about. to discuss now is truly where it shines. , and it is the very reason it dares to. be hyped up to over ten thousand yuan. today: large language model inference. deployment. In this arena, I have to. admit that it seems almost. frighteningly powerful. We used vLLM to. deploy two of the latest trending. models: one is the dense-architecture. Qwen 27B, and the other is the. MoE-architecture Mixtral 8x7B (35B),. both using AWQ int4 quantization. Let’s look at the single-stream. decoding generation speed: the 27B. model can hit 60 tokens per second. The. 35B model shoots straight up to 151. tokens per second, and both models. support Medusa speculative decoding. Once enabled, the 27B can surge past.

100 tokens, while the 35B can reach 180. tokens; the user experience is. literally at the level of cloud-based. APIs! And that is not even the most. outrageous part; let’s look at its. high-concurrency throughput. capabilities. The peak throughput for. both models occurs at 128 concurrent. requests, with the 27 B's total. throughput at 726 tokens per second,. and the 35B reaching nearly 4,000. tokens per second. When converted to. per-user experience, even with 32. people using it simultaneously, each. person gets 18 tokens per second on the. 27B, while the 35B provides 70 tokens. per second. Maintaining a usable or. even smooth state for dozens of. simultaneous requests on a single card. is incredible...As for the prefill. speed—the speed of injecting prompts. and documents—in a single-stream. state, the 27B handles 1,950 tokens per. second, while the 35B hits 7,300 tokens. per second, which gives the. conversation a very good response speed. . Although this prefill speed decays as. the context depth increases, thanks to. vLLM's context mechanism, every. conversation only requires prefixing. the newly input text. For scenarios. like RAG that repeatedly call on. previous text, the experience is also. exceptionally smooth and good. So, why. is this card so fast with large. language models? The core lies in the. 64GB of VRAM, which provides a massive. KV cache pool and a terrifying 1.6 TB/s. of memory bandwidth. Decoding is a task. that is typically bottlenecked by. bandwidth. For a side-by-side. comparison, running the same 27B model,. the more powerful 4090 only hits 40. tokens per second, while the newer 5090. reaches about 78 tokens per second. Combined with 64GB of VRAM, its context. limit for a single request can reach. 56K. If shared by multiple users, the. KV cache for the 27B model can hit 600K. tokens. This means two people can. simultaneously fill the context window. and still maintain a steady cache hit. rate without any pressure. If you're. using a 35B/A3B model, the KV cache can. be pushed to support 8 to 10 users,. nearly maxing out the context window. Though some might ask, isn't it cheap. to call cloud-based 2 B-level models. now? Why go through the trouble of. buying cards and setting them up. yourself? To verify this, we set up a. benchmarking environment to simulate. cloud API calls. In real-world business. scenarios, if you use complex research. workflows, you'll often trigger seven.

or eight agents calling the model in. the background simultaneously. We. crunched the numbers: for a single. complex task, even using a 27B model,. the token consumption alone would cost. between 10 to 20 yuan. If you run. several tasks at once, not only is it. expensive, but you'll likely hit the. cloud provider's concurrency limits,. resulting in errors or service. interruptions. But in this scenario,. our own locally deployed LLM. demonstrates a "dimensional reduction" advantage. Have you ever heard of local. deployment crushing cloud APIs like. this before? The concurrency speed we. just tested can easily withstand a. barrage of multiple agents without any. worry about costs, and there are no. warnings about limits due to multiple. user requests. The IQ of current models. like the 3.8 27B is genuinely. impressive and fully capable of. handling complex logical processing. So. , in terms of achieving. high-concurrency AI workflows and true. token freedom, we have to admit that. this 17HX is a hardcore card that. genuinely solves business pain points. Alright, having seen this, its. performance should be clear. If you. think this card is this capable,. wouldn't it be worth spending over. 10,000 yuan, or even buying a few more. to build a 128GB or 256GB server? However, we still need to look at this. objectively. When it was selling for a. few thousand, I felt it was a high-risk. , high-reward productivity card, but. now that it's risen to over 10,000, its. value for money has really been. squeezed quite a bit. Next, let's take. a look at several unavoidable. shortcomings in its hardware physical. architecture. The first is that the. card's architecture is a bit dated and. somewhat picky about model formats. The. 3090 simply lacks hardware acceleration. for FP8. If future community models. increasingly rely on new quantization. formats like INT8, FP8, or FP4, this. card will have to rely on. dequantization simulation to force it,. and the ecosystem adaptation cost will. keep rising. This is its most real. concern in the era of rapid AI. iteration. Fortunately, many current. CPY motherboard models have returned to. using INT8, which helps buffer that a. bit. Second is the small PCIe bandwidth. ; multi-card clusters will face a. bottleneck. Some might think about. buying several cards to build a cluster. for larger models, but note that this. card lacks NVLink; inter-card.

communication relies entirely on PCIe. Even if you bridge those capacitors,. the bus is only 2.0 x16, so the. bandwidth isn't sufficient. This leads. to a massive loss in performance for. tensor parallelism, which requires. frequent data exchange in multi-card. scenarios. If you switch to pipeline. parallelism with smaller communication. volumes, it basically can only serve a. single user. For the high-concurrency. performance that this card was. originally intended for, this is. actually a huge waste of resources. But. a common misunderstanding here is that,. for single-card use, this bandwidth. doesn't really impose much of a limit. If you're worried about model loading. speeds, there's no need, because 2.0. x16 is already equivalent to 4.0 x4. performance. Even if your model is. stored on an SSD, this speed likely. won't become a bottleneck for loading. The third issue is the potential risk. of being locked to a specific driver. version. The full performance of this. card relies on unlocking a. vulnerability, and that vulnerability. is in NVIDIA's hands. Once future. drivers patch it, the toolchain will. fail, so for now, to be conservative,. the driver is locked at the 610.43. version. An X version. Objectively. speaking, the 610 series driver is. relatively new for now, and daily use. is basically obstacle-free. However,. you must consider future hidden risks; if the open-source community releases. new models or tools that strictly. require a higher driver version, this. card will face the risk of being unable. to run them. The fourth issue is that. from a hardware perspective, it is a " purebred" mining card lacking any. fault-tolerance safeguards, which is. the most realistic concern. This is a. mining card that has been heavily taxed. in a mining farm for years, with no. warranty whatsoever, and there is. already community feedback about cards. failing after long-term high-load AI. tasks. Furthermore, this card lacks ECC. memory error correction. If the memory. degrades and causes calculation errors,. it won’t throw an error; it will. silently output incorrect results. If. you use it for serious scientific. computing or generating critical code,. you will have to bear the risks. yourself. Finally, the peripheral. configuration of this card is. effectively zero. It has no NVENC,. can't handle video hardware decoding or. transcoding, has no video output ports,. and doesn't even come with a fan, so.

you have to modify it yourself to fit. into a PC case. At this point, let's do. the math and answer the question from. the beginning: Is a card that once cost. a few hundred yuan, now selling for. over 10,000, actually worth it? I don't. think we can generalize. Based on the. core needs of users, we can divide them. into two categories. The first category. is: if you are a moderate user who. mainly focuses on AI image generation. and video production, my advice is that. at the price point of over 10,000 yuan,. I wouldn't really recommend buying it. Although its 64GB memory can handle. extreme specs like 108P 10-second clips. without running out of VRAM, you have. to face the reality that for the vast. majority of daily generation tasks, its. core computing power is only on par. with a 4070 or 4080. If you have 10,000. yuan for multimedia generation, there. are definitely more stable solutions. with better-matched computing power. For instance, you could buy a Pro W7800. with 32GB of VRAM or an AMD Radeon Pro. W7900 32GB for the same 10,000 yuan; these cards are not only competitive in. video production but also have newer. architectures and native, high-level. computing power. Most importantly, they. have a complete ecosystem, so you don't. need to worry about drivers, and they. even come with a standard warranty. Spending over 10,000 yuan on a weak. mining card just to generate images is. really not cost-effective. As for the. second type of user, if you are a. studio looking to deploy local large. language model services, objectively. speaking, this remains a highly. competitive piece of specialized. equipment on the market today. In terms. of local deployment, the 1.6 TB/s. bandwidth and massive 64GB of VRAM give. it an absolute edge in decoding speed. and high-concurrency throughput,. allowing it to go head-to-head with or. even outperform a $ 20,000 9048G card. If, like us, your business requires. high-frequency execution of multi-agent. collaboration and you're fed up with. cloud usage fees and frustrating. concurrency limits, then this card can. truly help you achieve freedom from. cloud costs. If you know Linux. deployment and can accept the lack of. support and the risk of the card. failing at any time, treating it. strictly as a local API server, then. this investment of over 10,000 yuan is. still a solid choice for a quick return. on investment. 摘要

硬體架構與雙卡配置

作者司波圖展示了為工作室量身打造的全新AIO伺服器，硬體核心採用銘瑄 AI MicroStation工作站準系統，搭載24核心處理器與96GB高容量記憶體。該機型最突出的特色在於上下分艙散熱設計，並直接配置了兩張具備32GB超大顯存的Intel Arc Pro B70專業繪圖卡，提供充裕的頻寬與獨立風道，為後續多模態大模型與複雜算力任務奠定了紮實基礎。

系統底層部署與顯卡任務切分

在系統軟體部分，作者選擇了能良好驅動新架構顯卡的Ubuntu作業系統，並全程透過OpenCode進行遠端無人化配置。為了最大化利用算力，兩張顯卡採獨立分工策略：GPU 0專門運行本地端Qwen 35B多模態大模型，利用其強大的KV Cache實現高達256K的上下文處理與多用戶高併發；GPU 1則部署ComfyUI創作環境，支援圖形與影片運算，使感知推理與內容生成互不干擾。

智慧感知與自動化代理中樞建置

作者將開源的MiLocal智慧監控與OpenClaw智慧體工具進行串接改造，徹底擺脫原版對雲端付費API的依賴。透過將視覺辨識與推理解析端點重新導向至本機的Qwen模型，並將影像來源擴充至通用RTSP協定，讓伺服器能夠自主提取監視器畫面進行結構化分析，再由OpenClaw自動觸發飛書通知或語音警告，達成全鏈路隱私安全且完全免費的本地自動化中樞。

實戰環境偵測與系統自癒維護

在實際運作中，這套系統展現了高度智能：攝影機不僅能透過白名單人臉辨識精準判斷人員身分，還能透過自然語言規則判斷員工是否長時間滑手機、於深夜偵測陌生人闖入，甚至在無專用模型下直接看懂機房冒煙並發布火災警報。此外，它亦承擔起自主維運角色，使用者可透過飛書以口語發布指令檢查伺服器、重啟容器，系統甚至能定時自主巡檢、自動修復當機服務並即時回報進度。

MiniMax H3 地端影片生成實測與未來潛力

在內容創作領域，作者利用B70的大顯存優勢實測最新開源的MiniMax H3影片生成模型。在未降質量的原始權重下，伺服器產出480p影片不到200秒，720p約10分鐘即可完成，並能精準依據提示詞實現鏡頭運鏡與分鏡轉換，已全面取代工作室原有的雲端付費算力。作者總結，雖然目前本地感知仍有樣本過少導致人臉誤認或事件偶發漏判的極限，但這套集感知、看守、自主維修與生成於一身的方案，已清楚確立了新一代AIO伺服器的發展標竿。

item.itunes:author: 司波图
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WkvXK_6gSBI

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入剖析價值萬元的「最強藍廠專業顯卡」銘瑄 Intel Arc Pro B70 32G Turbo 的極限效能與硬體設計。
  • 實測本地 AI 大模型（LLM）與 AI 繪圖/影片生成（ComfyUI）的真實算力，評估 32GB 大容量顯示記憶體帶來的優勢。
  • 詳解如何在 Linux 環境與 vLLM 框架下，將顯卡推理算力榨乾至 500+ TPS 的高吞吐量狀態。
  • 展示虛擬化玩家最嚮往的 SR-IOV 頂級硬體直通技術，輕鬆實現「一卡分七」的家庭雲端桌面與 GPU 容器部署。

摘要

銘瑄 Arc Pro B70 規格與硬體架構

作者首先介紹了這張被譽為最強藍卡皇的銘瑄 Intel Arc Pro B70 32G Turbo。這是一張擁有單晶片 32GB GDDR6 顯示記憶體的專業計算卡。它採用標準的渦輪散熱設計、雙插槽尺寸，最大功耗約為 250W。相較於前代雙晶片的 B60，B70 避開了雙晶片通信的效能損耗，擁有更純粹且完整的記憶體頻寬與規格，非常適合多卡 AI 運算、伺服器以及虛擬化部署。

Windows 生態下的生產力與遊戲表現

在 Windows 系統中，這張卡的遊戲圖形效能大約等同於 RTX 3060 Ti，能流暢應付 2K 解析度遊戲，但因其萬元的定價，並不適合作為純遊戲卡。然而在剪輯生產力方面，得益於 Intel 強大的雙 Xe 媒體引擎，在 DaVinci Resolve 中剪輯多軌 4K H.265 規格的高碼率影片時，能實現滿幀且無卡頓的流暢回放，展現出極佳的影音生產力。

Windows 與 Linux 環境下的大模型極限實測

作者對本地大模型（LLM）的推理表現進行了深度測試。在 Windows 下使用 Llama.cpp 時，若採用 Vulkan 後端會遇到大上下文崩潰的 Bug，必須切換至 SYCL 後端才能穩定運行。為了徹底釋放算力，作者將系統切換至 Ubuntu，並部署了 Intel 官方推薦的 vLLM (LM-Scaler) 容器。在 vLLM 框架下，單卡推理速度大幅飆升，單用戶初始輸出可達 108 TPS，而在進行 32 人高併發測試時，總吞吐量更是突破 500+ TPS，並能完美利用 Prefix Caching 減少延遲。

ComfyUI 跑圖與 AI 影片生成

擁有 32GB 超大顯示記憶體的 B70 讓用戶在 ComfyUI 中徹底告別了顯示記憶體焦慮。用戶可以直接常駐載入 FP16 原版大模型，無需使用任何精簡或量化手段。實測在生成高難度的 AI 影片時，單卡生成一段 1080P、5 秒的 LTX 高質量影片僅需約 140 秒，效能相當絲滑，是本地 AI 創作者的強大工具。

夢幻級 SR-IOV 虛擬化「一卡多分配」

對於玩機與虛擬化愛好者，這張專業卡原生支援 SR-IOV 硬體級直通技術。作者成功將其「一卡分七」，最多可分割出 7 個 vGPU，並將顯示記憶體均勻分配給不同的虛擬機或 GPU 容器。這使得用戶能輕鬆搭建多路雲端桌面，或是在家用伺服器中，讓多個 Docker 容器同時調用 GPU 進行硬體解碼與 AI 計算，展現出極高的部署價值。

=============

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WkvXK_6gSBI

之前给大伙测过双芯的B60，今天，正统的单芯32G海量显存猛兽终于来了！ 被称为“最强蓝厂显卡”的铭瑄 Intel Arc Pro B70 32G Turbo，目前售价一万块左右。 告别双芯通信损耗，这块拥有完整32G纯正显存的专业计算卡，到底能给目前的本地AI、生产力工作流以及AIO虚拟化带来多大的颠覆？

这期视频我们不玩虚的，直接上极限压力测试！帮你排雷Windows生态，并深度压榨Linux环境下的终极算力。折腾了几天几夜，终于测出了这张卡的“最强形态”！

🔥 本期核心硬核看点： 🧠 大模型极限压榨： 逃离Windows生态封印，切入Linux vLLM！单卡轻松装下 35B 高智商模型，32人高并发总吞吐量狂飙 500+ TPS！ 🎨 无脑AI跑图/视频： 32G大显存告别“算计”！ComfyUI原版模型丝滑常驻，单卡生成 1080P/5秒 LTX高质量视频仅需140秒。 💻 AIO玩家梦中情卡： 消费级显卡难搞的虚拟化？它原生支持 SR-IOV 硬件级直通，无痛“一卡分七”，轻松搞定全家云桌面与GPU容器！ 🎬 剪辑生产力拉满： 强大的双Xe媒体引擎，达芬奇H.265多轨高规格素材满帧回放。
